name: Boston Conservatory at Berklee — BFA in Dance
degree: BFA in Dance (Contemporary Dance Performance OR Commercial Dance)

fit.note: TWO BFAs — Contemporary Dance Performance AND Commercial Dance (75-min jazz + freestyle audition). Excellent fit either way.

rounds.label: Early Action

academicDeadline.note: Deadlines page (no longer bot-blocked) confirms: "Your application and pre-screen materials (if applicable) must be completed by this date" = Nov 1. Supporting documents (transcripts, recs, online interview) due separately by Dec 1.

artsSupplementDeadline.note: Pre-screen (if required) due with the application, Nov 1.

decisionRelease.note: Deadlines page: "Notification of Early Action admissions and scholarship decisions are issued" Jan 31.

rounds.notes: EA audition completion cutoff confirmed as Jan 21 on the deadlines page ("Auditions to the Dance, Music, and Theater Divisions completed by January 21 are Early-Action eligible"). Note: the audition-dates-and-locations page footnote instead says auditioning "by January 20" for EA eligibility — minor Jan 20 vs Jan 21 discrepancy between the two official pages, unresolved.

rounds.label: Regular Action

academicDeadline.note: Confirmed via deadlines page: "Your application and pre-screen materials (if applicable) must be submitted by this date" = Dec 1 (pre-screen materials recommended by Nov 1). Supporting documents due separately by Jan 15.

decisionRelease.note: Deadlines page: undergraduate admission/financial-aid notification issued Apr 1; tuition deposit due May 1.

rounds.notes: Supporting documents (transcripts, recommendation letters, online interview) due Jan 15.

portal.note: Application-steps page: "Select programs at Boston Conservatory at Berklee require a pre-screen, submitted through a platform called SlideRoom" — that sentence doesn't name Dance specifically, but Boston Conservatory's SlideRoom portal exists at bostonconservatoryatberklee.slideroom.com (confirmed via search; portal itself is JS-rendered and could not be scraped to confirm Dance is listed there). Spot-check with a browser before relying on this.

fee.value: $75 application fee if submitted by Nov 1 (EA) / $150 if submitted by Dec 1 (RA) — no separate audition fee identified
fee.note: Application-steps page gives tiered application fees by submission date; no distinct "audition fee" line item found on any fetched page for Dance.

deadline.note: Prescreen/audition materials due with the RA application (Dec 1); recommended by Nov 1.

prescreenRequired.note: Re-confirmed: pre-recorded material submitted; for the online option, ballet + modern submitted 48h before the live online audition. Page still does not tie any of this explicitly to "Fall 2027" or the "2026-27" cycle.

value.text: 90-second solo with self-provided accompaniment. Contemporary: ballet/modern preferred (not required). Commercial: any style incl. hip-hop, tap, jazz, circus.
For the live-online option: pre-recorded ballet + modern material, submitted 48 hours before the online audition.

auditions.label: Live audition — Contemporary Dance Performance
auditions.city: Boston, MA (+ tour: Atlanta, Chicago, New York, Los Angeles)

date.note: Earliest of many announced in-person dates shared by both tracks (soonest-upcoming, used as the canonical single value for this Fact). Full list per the audition-dates-and-locations page — EA-eligible dates marked with *: Nov 14, 2026* (Boston, on campus), Nov 21, 2026* (Boston, on campus), Jan 3, 2027* (Atlanta, GA), Jan 5, 2027* (Chicago, IL), Jan 7, 2027* (New York, NY), Jan 8, 2027* (New York, NY), Jan 17, 2027* (Boston, on campus — Contemporary only), Jan 24, 2027 (Los Angeles, CA), Jan 30, 2027 (Boston, on campus), Feb 6, 2027 (Boston, on campus). Page text doesn't literally say "Fall 2027"/"2026-27," though the date range only makes sense for that cycle.

registrationOpens.note: No fixed registration-opens date: applicants "schedule auditions through the application portal under 'My Events'"; scheduling instructions arrive by email within 48 hours of application submission.

registrationDeadline.note: No fixed registration deadline stated — tied to individual applicant's application-submission date, not a calendar date.

auditions.notes: Two technique classes: one ballet + one modern (pointe not required). Jan 17, 2027 on-campus date is Contemporary-only (Commercial's exclusive on-campus date is Jan 16 instead).

auditions.label: Live audition — Commercial Dance
auditions.city: Boston, MA (+ tour: Atlanta, Chicago, New York, Los Angeles)

date.note: Same shared schedule as Contemporary Dance Performance except the Boston-on-campus-only date, which for Commercial is Jan 16, 2027 (not Jan 17). Full list, EA-eligible dates marked *: Nov 14, 2026* (Boston), Nov 21, 2026* (Boston), Jan 3, 2027* (Atlanta, GA), Jan 5, 2027* (Chicago, IL), Jan 7, 2027* (New York, NY), Jan 8, 2027* (New York, NY), Jan 16, 2027* (Boston — Commercial only), Jan 24, 2027 (Los Angeles, CA), Jan 30, 2027 (Boston), Feb 6, 2027 (Boston). Page doesn't literally say "Fall 2027"/"2026-27."

registrationOpens.note: No fixed registration-opens date: scheduled via the application portal's "My Events" after applying; instructions emailed within 48 hours of submission.

registrationDeadline.note: No fixed registration deadline stated — tied to individual applicant's application-submission date.

auditions.notes: 75-min jazz technique class + 45-min freestyle class + faculty interview. Strong commercial fit.

auditions.label: Live online (virtual) audition

date.note: Two online audition dates announced: Dec 5, 2026 (EA-eligible, per asterisk) and Feb 13, 2027 (Regular Action only). Using the earlier as the canonical value. Page doesn't literally say "Fall 2027"/"2026-27."

registrationOpens.note: No fixed registration-opens date: scheduled via the application portal's "My Events" after applying; instructions emailed within 48 hours of submission.

registrationDeadline.note: No fixed registration deadline stated — tied to individual applicant's application-submission date.

auditions.notes: Pre-recorded ballet/modern 48h ahead + live online solo + faculty conversation. Great for a San Juan applicant. Second virtual date Feb 13, 2027 is Regular-Action only (not EA-eligible).

testPolicy.note: FAQ page confirms: "SAT or ACT scores are not required as part of our application process." No explicit tie to "Fall 2027"/"2026-27" — appears to be a standing policy.

recommendations.note: Still ambiguous: application-steps page states "At least one recommendation letter is required for applicants to all music programs" but does not explicitly extend this to Dance or Theater. No fetched page (application-steps, audition-process, dance-audition-requirements, FAQ) states a Dance-specific recommendation requirement — verify directly with admissions.

value.prompt: No essays or personal statements required. FAQ page: "Boston Conservatory at Berklee does not require essays, personal statements, or SAT/ACT scores to complete an application."

interview.value: Faculty interview (Commercial Dance audition includes one)

amount.note: No dollar amount published on the financial-aid page — awarded competitively per audition, no fixed figure found.

deadline.note: Re-confirmed: "If the FAFSA has been filled out by March 1, Boston Conservatory at Berklee will take the family's financial need into consideration when awarding scholarship aid."

requiresSeparateApp.note: Re-confirmed: "All entering students are automatically considered for institutional scholarships as part of the admissions process"; "There is no separate application for institutional scholarship consideration."

cssProfileRequired.note: Still unresolved: fetched both the financial-aid page and the "Determining Financial Need" page (https://bostonconservatory.berklee.edu/financial-aid/determining-financial-need) — neither mentions CSS Profile at all, only FAFSA. Absence isn't proof it's not required; leaving as tbd rather than inferring false.

tuitionAnnual.value: $55,120/year ($27,560/semester tuition only, B.M./B.F.A.) + $2,500/year comprehensive fees + $2,781/year health insurance
tuitionAnnual.note: Page headed "2026-2027 Tuition and Fees" (Fall 2026 & Spring 2027 rates); Board of Trustees approved a 3% increase for 2026-2027. This is the current-year published rate — Fall 2027 (2027-28) rates are not yet posted.

totalCostOfAttendance.value: $87,817/year (2026-2027, includes tuition, fees, on-campus housing/meals, health insurance, books, and other estimated costs)
totalCostOfAttendance.note: Page explicitly labeled academic year "2026–2027." This is the current-year published COA — Fall 2027 (2027-28) COA is not yet posted.

cohortSize.value: ~30-40 new freshmen/year (Contemporary Dance Performance); ~20-25 new freshmen/year (Commercial Dance)
cohortSize.note: FAQ page: overall enrollment "approximately 840 students"; incoming dance class "30 to 40 new dance students for contemporary dance, and between 20 to 25 students for commercial dance." General/standing figure, not tied explicitly to Fall 2027.

acceptanceRate.note: Not published on the FAQ, dance-audition-requirements, or admissions pages fetched this session.

companyAffiliation.note: No professional-company affiliation found on any fetched page (dance-audition-requirements, audition-process, FAQ) — unlike some peer programs, Boston Conservatory's Dance division doesn't appear tied to a named company.

notable.value: Two distinct BFA tracks (Contemporary Performance + Commercial); part of Berklee.
